ITDcarry

Thinuka’s three-minute pitch
6 slides · 4 demo steps · you control the pace
All media is included. No internet needed.

Speak using the included script. The presentation has no recorded narration.

0:00 / 3:00

Controls

Next / Right arrow / Space / Page Down: next demo step or slide Back / Left arrow / Page Up: previous demo step or slide On slide 4, click any of the four step labels to jump straight to it. R: replay a slide or reset the demo to step 1 · F: fullscreen Every demo step holds until you choose to move on. Aim for about three minutes, with time to point and pause.

Sources and demo scope

The demo is a Remotion animation of actual local getITD output and the repository’s exact matcher/reference verdict. It is not a screen recording of the hosted web application. Daytona and Neo4j were not run. Evidence files are included in the package.
